text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… It's harder than it looks, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I'm sure I wouldn't have done any better.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I could tell by the look on your face that you were trying your best.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's more than enough for me—plushie or no plushie.
